items.name: Cacophony
items.text: 20 feet. The terns' awful racket of screeches and howls drowns out other sounds. Any creature performing an auditory action in the area must yell over the din, requiring a successful DC 15 Fortitude save save or DC 15 Performance check check to project loudly enough; on a failure, the action is lost.

items.name: Ransack
items.text:
The swarm rummages through the possessions of a single creature within its space, attempting a Thievery check check against the creature's Reflex DC.

On a success, the terns take one random item of negligible Bulk that the creature is wearing but not closely guarding, such as an object in a loosely carried pouch.

items.name: Swarming Bites
items.text: Each creature in the swarm's space takes 1d8 piercing damage (DC 18 basic Reflex save save).
